Click a player for their abilities: damage, uses, hits, misses and healing, then where their damage taken came from and what healed them. Damage is the HP the monsters lost, read from the game's battle messages: overkill is not counted. DPS runs over time in combat: from the first wave's start to the last hit, without a break between waves. A dungeon run is listed here only when the script saw it from wave 1 to its end (a reload in the middle of a wave is stitched back in; installing an update reloads the page, so that run is cut). On a planet a session runs until the battle changes, across reloads. Runs seen only in part still count: pick that dungeon's totals in the Session list. Parry and thorns are counter-attacks; damage over time is put on the ability that applied it. Healing done counts heal abilities, Life Drain and Bloom; everything else a player regained (regeneration, food, passives) shows under Healed. Click a session below to show it.

Cost per key = the average of the key crafts this record has seen (materials at their purchase price, plus the recipe's coins); until one is seen, the recipe at the materials' purchase prices (asks for materials never bought) with every input cut by the game's artisan rate (tea × Guzzling Pouch, as the game reports it) plus the tea's share of the craft time, and the key's own ask only when a material has no price at all. Keys held before the record began are priced the same way. Used at cost charges each live clear the exact lot it took; offline and older clears use the craft average. At start = held when the record began, priced at ask then.
